name: Voice Clone
desc: Sing or speak in another voice: give it the vocals of a song and a few seconds of the voice you want, and Seed-VC AI re-sings them in that voice, keeping the melody, the rhythm and the words. Runs on this computer, on the graphics card when there is one: no account, no API key, nothing uploaded. The voice model (1.6 GB) is downloaded once, on first use.
